h1: UJ Apartment — a budget stay under THB 1,000 within walking distance of Bangsaen Beach, owner-run and well suited to budget travelers, couples, and people running errands around Saen Suk
intro: If you're looking for a place to stay around Bangsaen that isn't a pricey beachfront hotel, but rather "a clean room you can walk to the sea from, at a budget price, with an owner who looks after you like you're staying at a relative's house," UJ Apartment is a name worth keeping on your list · It's a small apartment with just 12 rooms, located on Thanon Long Hat Bangsaen (the road down to Bangsaen Beach), Saen Suk, Mueang Chon Buri, in a spot that's about a 10-minute walk to Bangsaen Beach · The thing guests mention most often is that the rooms are clean and fresh-smelling, the AC is cold, the water pressure in the bathroom is strong, and the owner is attentive — and many reviews note that they speak both English and Chinese and help guests beyond what you'd expect · It suits budget travelers, couples, students and parents around Burapha University, and people running errands in Saen Suk who want a clean room within walking distance of the sea without paying beachfront-hotel prices · There's free parking and free Wi-Fi, with prices from about THB 576/night · scored 8.9 from 102 reviews on Trip.com and about 8.1 on Booking.com

body.html: UJ Apartment overview — who it suits — To put it as briefly as possible, UJ Apartment is a small, budget-friendly owner-run apartment for people who want "a clean room within walking distance of Bangsaen Beach" more than a resort atmosphere or luxury facilities · It's not a beachfront hotel where you step out of your room onto the sand, there's no swimming pool, no fitness room, and no buffet breakfast · Instead it's a small building with just 12 rooms in the Saen Suk area, designed for "sleeping clean and comfortable, close to the sea on a light budget" · Voices from real reviews line up on this: the people it suits are budget travelers who want to walk over to swim in the sea and come back to a clean room, couples who want a quiet, private place, students and parents with business near Burapha University, and people who drive in themselves and want free parking · Another group that says they were impressed is solo international travelers, because many reviews mention the owner who speaks both English and Chinese, helping out and giving sightseeing tips like you're staying at a relative's house · Put simply, this place plays on "a budget stay that's cleaner than its price suggests, and close enough to the sea to walk" — which isn't easy to find in the Bangsaen area

Location and getting around — UJ Apartment is at 408/4 on Thanon Long Hat Bangsaen (the road down to Bangsaen Beach), Saen Suk, Mueang Chon Buri · The standout of this location is that it's in the real Bangsaen area, about a 10-minute walk to Bangsaen Beach as many reviews confirm, so even people without a car can comfortably walk over to swim and find food along the beach · Within a short distance there are several of Bangsaen's main attractions, including the Marine Science Institute (about 580 m), the Underwater World learning center (about 550 m), the Bangsaen roundabout (about 480 m), and Burapha University (about 700 m) · This is a location that works for both beach visitors and people coming for business around the university · For people from Bangkok, it's about a 1-hour-30-minute drive to Bangsaen via the motorway, with free parking at the apartment itself · One thing worth saying plainly is that some reviews note the property sits deep inside a soi (lane), so if you arrive at night for the first time you may need to watch for the entrance a little · But overall it's genuinely a location within walking distance of the sea and Bangsaen's main sights — an advantage many budget stays in Chon Buri can't offer

"The room was very clean, fresh-smelling the moment you walk in, the AC cold and the shower nice and strong, just a ten-minute walk to Bangsaen Beach. The owner was lovely, spoke English and even recommended places to visit. For this price it's better value than I expected for Bangsaen."

Room types and decor — UJ Apartment is a small building with only 12 rooms, but it still splits them into a few types to suit your group size and style · It starts with the Standard Room with a Queen bed, one large bed, good for couples or solo travelers who want a clean room at a light price · There's a Standard Room with twin beds, two single beds for friends or siblings traveling together, and the room many people are especially interested in is the Modern Loft Room, decorated in a loft style that looks more modern than the standard rooms · Every room has the essentials for a real stay — a fridge, flat-screen TV, tea/coffee kettle, work desk, and bathroom amenities — plus daily housekeeping · Most real reviews agree in praising that the rooms are clean and fresh-smelling, the AC cold, the bathroom water pressure strong, and the in-room items complete and actually usable — the three or four things daily-stay guests weight most heavily · Some reviews also mention rooms with a reasonable amount of usable space and a balcony in some rooms · The honest caveat is that this is a small owner-run building, so some furniture looks plain in line with the budget price, and a minority of reviews say the bed is fairly firm for some people, so set your expectations correctly: it's a clean, good-value stay, not a designer room in a big hotel

Facilities (no pool, but enough for a comfortable sleep) — Let's be straight from the start: UJ Apartment has no swimming pool, no fitness room, and no breakfast, because it's a small owner-run apartment rather than a full-service hotel · But for a real stay in the Bangsaen area, it has the essentials in reasonable measure · The highlight guests praise most is the cleanliness, which many reviews stress: rooms are clean and fresh-smelling from the moment you open the door · On top of that there's free parking, which helps people who drive in a lot in the Bangsaen area where parking is hard to find on holidays, free Wi-Fi that works throughout, basic reception and room service, plus in-room items like a fridge, kettle, and hairdryer that many reviews mention are all provided · So this place's strength isn't "resort toys" but cleanliness and basic convenience done better than the price suggests, plus a location within walking distance of the beach — which fits budget guests who come to enjoy the sea and use the room mainly to sleep, more accurately than a pool they might never use

Food and nearby places — UJ Apartment has no breakfast and isn't a place you come to in order to eat on-site, so set your expectations that meals rely mainly on the surrounding eateries, which is normal for a small apartment-style stay · The good news is that the Bangsaen area is full of tasty food within walking and short-driving distance · Bangsaen beachfront, about a 10-minute walk away, has seafood restaurants, som tam (papaya salad) stalls, grilled chicken, and beachside snacks to choose from all along the strip · The Saen Suk area itself has rice shops, made-to-order eateries, cafes, and convenience stores spread all around, since it's a university area with plenty of student-priced food · If you want to seriously eat Chon Buri's famous fare, a few minutes' drive gets you to Nong Mon Market, known for its souvenirs and dried seafood · For those who want to save, having a fridge and kettle in every room makes it easy to buy things to store or heat up in the room yourself · Overall, food at UJ is about "easily relying on nearby eateries and beachside food" rather than being a selling point of the property itself — which fits the Bangsaen travel style, where most people head out to find food anyway

Service and care — This is what wins guests over most at UJ Apartment, and it's something mentioned over and over in real reviews · Because it's a small owner-run apartment, many reviews tell the same story: the owner is friendly, attentive, and helps guests beyond expectations, from a smooth check-in to recommending places to visit and restaurants in Bangsaen · What international travelers praise in particular is that the owner speaks both English and Chinese, making communication easy and giving solo travelers peace of mind · Small touches like this are what big chain hotels often can't provide, and it's the reason this place's review score reaches as high as 8.9 even though it's a budget stay · For the sake of honesty, a very small number of reviews (about 1 in 102) raise a note about the manager's attitude at certain moments and the condition of some parts of the room that are starting to show age, such as bathroom maintenance · But against the overwhelming praise, the overall picture on service remains this place's clearest strength

Voices from real reviews (both praise and gripes) — Pulling from Trip.com, Booking.com and other booking platforms, the picture is fairly consistent · On the praise side: rooms are clean and fresh-smelling, the AC cold, the bathroom water pressure strong, about a 10-minute walk to Bangsaen Beach, the owner friendly and helpful beyond expectations and speaks English and Chinese, free parking, in-room items complete with a fridge and kettle, and great value for a location within walking distance of the sea · On the caveat side: what gets mentioned (from a minority of reviews) is the condition of some parts of the room starting to show age, such as bathroom maintenance or the mirror in some rooms, a fairly firm bed for some people, the fact that there's no swimming pool and no breakfast for those expecting a resort-hotel feel, and the fact that the property sits deep in a soi, so finding the entrance the first time may take a little watching · These gripes are mostly about setting your expectations right (a small budget apartment, not a resort) rather than being big problems that keep people from returning, and the majority of voices are still clearly positive

"The place is small but genuinely clean, the owner takes great care of you, you can walk to the beach, and the price is just right · My only small gripes are that parts of the bathroom are starting to show age and the bed is fairly firm, but for this price and this location it's very okay. Next time I'm in Bangsaen I'll stay here again."

Price comparison and value — UJ Apartment clearly positions itself in Bangsaen's budget accommodation group · Prices start at about THB 576/night for a Standard Room in regular periods, and move up by room type (Twin / Modern Loft) and during long weekends or festivals, generally still in the few-hundred to low-thousand-baht-per-night range · What makes this place especially good value is its location, genuinely within walking distance of Bangsaen Beach at a budget price, whereas most beachfront or near-beach stays in this area price much higher · Combined with the cleanliness guests consistently praise, free parking, and the owner's highly rated service, that makes UJ a choice that's excellent value within Bangsaen's budget accommodation group · But the trade-off is no pool, no breakfast, a small number of rooms that fill up fast in high season, and a small building where some parts are starting to show age · If the goal of your trip is "sleep clean, save money, walk to the sea, and get an owner who takes good care of you," every baht spent at UJ comes back as good value · But if the goal is a swimming pool, a sea view from the room, or full-service-hotel service, the lower price comes with limits you'll need to accept

What to know before booking — There are several things that help make the stay smoother · One, this place has only 12 rooms — rooms fill up fast during Bangsaen's long weekends and high season, so book ahead, especially on Saturdays and Sundays and during festivals · Two, this place has no breakfast and no swimming pool, so plan to find food from the nearby eateries and the beachfront, of which there are plenty in this area · Three, the property sits deep in a soi, so if you arrive at night for the first time, try calling the owner to ask for directions or open a navigation map clearly first · Four, if you're particular about how soft the bed is or the condition of the bathroom, try asking or requesting photos of the exact room you'll get before confirming, since it's a small building and each room may differ · Five, choose a free-cancellation option first if your plans aren't firm, and compare prices across platforms (Agoda / Booking / Trip.com), since the rate on each channel can differ · Six, if you drive in yourself, let the owner know about the free parking in advance for convenience

Summary — From all the real reviews, UJ Apartment is the best fit for budget travelers, couples, students and parents around Burapha University, and people running errands in Saen Suk who want a clean room within walking distance of Bangsaen Beach at a budget price · The strengths guests mention consistently are clean, fresh-smelling rooms, cold AC, strong water pressure, free parking, and above all an owner who is attentive and speaks several languages — which is why this budget stay scores as high as 8.9 in reviews · But you have to accept honestly that there's no swimming pool, no breakfast, it's a small building where some parts are starting to show age, and it has few rooms so it fills up fast · If you're looking for a beachfront resort with a pool and a sea view from the room, or full-service-hotel service, this may not be the answer, and you should consider stays along Bangsaen Beach or Wonnapha Beach instead · But for a budget Bangsaen trip where you want a clean room, walking distance to the sea, and an owner who looks after you like you're staying at a relative's house — UJ Apartment meets that need so well that a rival at the same price is hard to find
